rationale: Level-2 events (WWI/WWII, 1918 flu, the Great Chinese Famine, Taiping) happened several times per century historically, and the broad 'lastingly loses decent living conditions' criterion makes climate, resource and state-breakdown routes to 1% of humanity fairly likely over 75 years, so I put about a third of futures at exactly level 2 on top of the settled level-3+ mass (roughly 77% level 2+ in total in both cases). Superintelligence shifts mass from climate, resources and disease toward AI, war and civil breakdown, while the no-SI case is weighted toward slow climate and resource deprivation and includes worlds where a catastrophe stopped SI; AI takeover risk is mostly bimodal, so its level-2 share sits only modestly above its level-3+ share.
